en.t: There was no sign of anyone inside the temple gate.

units.source_text: 一片嫩绿丛中，点缀着许多小庙的瓦脊，似是一本这瞬间，所谓战争算什么呢？

en.t: Amid the expanse of tender green, the tiled ridges of many small temple buildings were scattered like ornaments; at this moment, what did this thing called war amount to?

units.source_text: 某个时期，战争使人觉得像是只存在于人的意识中的奇怪的精神上的事件。

en.t: At certain times, war made people feel as if it were a strange spiritual event that existed only in human consciousness.
